title: Games open on snapshot 1 which is boring — find a better default starting position
description:
When you open a game replay, it starts on snapshot 1 which is before players have even drawn starting hands. This is the least interesting point in the game and gives a bad first impression.

Ideas to make this better:
- Default to the first snapshot after mulligans are resolved and both players have drawn opening hands
- Look for the first snapshot where the turn counter is >= 1 (actual gameplay has started)
- Default to the first snapshot where a player has cards on the battlefield
- Add a heuristic that skips past the pregame phase

The golden test viewer already defaults to the final snapshot (good for testing). The game replay viewer should find a similarly smart default for the 'most interesting starting point'.
